title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(田中基嗣研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Tanaka Mototsugu)
educationalGoal: Students will:(1) Acquire the ability to identify and solve problems to research, develop, design, and manufacture socially useful and high-quality products using the basic knowledge learned in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, (2) Learn what technologies or new mechanisms are needed for that purpose, and (3) Learn about the importance of collaboration with society (particularly local communities).
advice: This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. To realize the educational objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering, this course focuses on the following goals: Students will acquire the ability to model phenomena accurately and analyze the models. Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to evaluate solutions based on the obtained results. In practice, students should reconfirm their project theme, which was determined in Preparatory Seminar, with the supervisors of the individual laboratories. (The theme should be revised as necessary.) Students are expected to pursue the identification and solution of problems in accordance with the engineering process. This laboratory focuses on the advanced composite materials. In addition, we also investigate approaches to apply conventional advanced technologies and knowledge to composite materials for other fields, such as the global environment, regenerative medicine, cellular biomechanics, tissue engineering, and biomimetics. The new results obtained by these trials provide feedback to many fields, such as mechanical and aeronautical engineering. Thus, we aim to cultivate flexible and comprehensive thinking abilities regardless of the academic field.
books: Textbooks: None specified Reference books: None specified Reserved books: None specified
requiredKnowledge: Fundamental knowledge from broad fields is necessary. In addition, students should obtain operating licenses for the machines installed in the "Yume-Kobo" and carefully read and understand the “thinking-way/attitude/rules for the investigation” and the “items to be observed to ensure the safety” prescribed in this lab. It is also necessary to maintain an attitude of feeling pleasure while understanding and absorbing essential new knowledge and see an organic connection with existing knowledge.

activityGoals.body: Be able to advance your project in accordance with the engineering design process.
Be able to compile the results correctly into an article and discuss the content through presentations.
Be able to act independently to solve the issues presented separately.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Understand the purpose of your project and the advancement process accurately, and achieve the established annual goal. The process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System. (2) Compile and present the intermediate results for the project into the interim report. Complete the final report, present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board. (3) If necessary, design and manufacture your own experimental devices, and also evaluate the performance of the product. (The numbers in the text correspond to those of the student’s action goals.)
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the purpose of your project theme and the advancement process, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System. (2) Compile intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present its content. Complete the final report and present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board. (3) Design and manufacture your own experimental devices if necessary. (The numbers in the text correspond to those of the student's action goals.)

lessons.content: April: Course introduction Master the operation of experimental equipment in this laboratory through the "VaRTM" championship Carefully read previous master theses and project reports from Design Project III
May: Consider and choose the research topics

June: Improve your experimental and analytical skills and check your ability to reproduce results by repeating previous studies (preliminary study on the research topics) Survey the related literature
July: Consider the feasibility of the focused research topics Pursue the research topics
August: Pursue the research topics Modify the research topics based on the discussion at the interim presentation
December: Pursue the research topics Modify the research topics based on discussion at the interim presentation
January: Pursue the research topics Write the project report
February: Complete the project report Present and discuss on your project report Prepare the transfer documents
